name: plan-flow
description: Draws Claude's current plan inside Claude Code: a live tree above the prompt and a card flowchart in a side drawer (/flow).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, drawer and toasts; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, then English

autoShow.title: Show the plan on its own
autoShow.description: Show the plan tree above the prompt as soon as a plan starts; off shows it only after /flow

enabled.title: Run in new sessions
enabled.description: Run plan-flow in each new session; off, a session starts with no board and no model calls until /flow on

design.title: Claude designs the plan
design.description: After each answer that followed work, ask Claude, in a fork of the conversation, to reshape the plan; off, only Haiku keeps the board
